Title: Azure Scheduler will be retired on 31 January 2022

Body.Content:
We announced the retirement of Azure Scheduler in late 2018 and extended the retirement date to December 2019. We understand adjusting to change is challenging and have extended the retirement date to 31 January 2022.

To continue using jobs you've configured in Azure Scheduler, please move to Azure Logic Apps before 31 January 2022 to take advantage of your familiar features and advanced capabilities. These include:

  • Using a visual designer and connectors to integrate with many services, including Azure Blob storage, Azure Service Bus, Microsoft Outlook, and SAP.
  • Manage each schedule as individual Azure resource.
  • Run multiple one-time jobs using a single logic app.
  • Set schedules that automatically adjust to daylight saving time.

Required action

Start moving your scheduled jobs to Logic Apps before 31 January 2022 by reviewing the migration guidance and FAQ. If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A, or contact logicappsemail@microsoft.com.
